name: dogfood-edge-durable-object-migration-app
description: Dogfood app v1.43-3 — a DurableObject state migration observability harness driven behind a provider-neutral surface backed by @kiwa-test/edge v1.2 advanced do-state-migration semantics (initiateMigration + bumpSchema + migrateInstance + completeRollout + rollbackMigration) + real-driver env-gate. Two adapter implementations satisfy the same 12-op contract: makeMockAdapter walks the edge do-state-migration state machine deterministically without any backend; makeRealAdapter emits a Cloudflare Workers Durable Objects + Vercel Edge session-affinity + Deno Deploy stateful-object style class-migration + zero-downtime rollout API sequence through the KIWA_MODE=real testcontainers-driven stack when KIWA_EDGE_DO_URL / KIWA_EDGE_DO_MIGRATION_URL / KIWA_EDGE_DO_ROLLBACK_URL are wired, and otherwise reports KIWA_EDGE_DO_MIGRATION_ENV_MISSING so callers can budget the fallback. The fidelity harness diffs both traces side-by-side across 3 lifecycle stages (schema-bump / data-migrate / rollout) x 3 edge platforms (cloudflare / vercel / deno) so behavioural drift between mock semantics and real DO migration APIs stays observable and feeds the @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/edge build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
